flags.name: --for
flags.description: command IDs, comma lists, or family.* wildcards to describe

flags.name: --limits
flags.description: print the full limit set without command contracts

flags.name: --outputs
flags.description: include schema.output trees and shared $defs; implies inline schemas

flags.name: --errors
flags.description: look up these error codes (comma list) in the error catalog without the other contracts; --for restricts the commands

constraints.description: supply --for once; --for and --limits are mutually exclusive
